title: Bosonic quantum mixtures with competing interactions: quantum liquid droplets and supersolids
summary: These lecture notes contain an introduction to quantum simulation of bosonic systems in the continuum, focusing on weakly interacting Bose-Bose mixtures with competing mean-field interactions. When the values of such interactions are fine-tuned to almost completely cancel the mean-field energy, quantum fluctuations become apparent and dominate the behavior of the system, stabilizing an ultradilute quantum liquid phase.
